observations: A focused regression test failed before the fix: a stale account lookup rebound volume preferences to a previous account, so 175% was not persisted for the current account.
The completed fix ignores both stale successful and stale failed account lookups before mutating preferences or error state.
A Web Audio unit test applies 0%, 175%, and 200% to one participant gain, leaves another at 100%, and restores the first level after track replacement.
